text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Good evening, everyone. Do you mind if I 
join you for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, okay! Come on over, come on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So, what do you need? Scouting on me?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! I just wanted to talk with everyone 
and get closer to you all—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Kya! It's the patrol!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hurry, hurry! We have to hide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Whoa-oof! Wait, Royce-kun!?"
(Step, step, step, step...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, there's no reason to hide! Wasn't that 
your Trainer just now?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was that how it was?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, the thrill makes it pretty 
fun! Next time, I'm gonna be the first one 
to hide!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
So... What did you want to talk about, 
Royce?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to late-night camp chats, 
it's all about... R-O-M-A-N-C-E! ♡

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Not interested.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Nothing to share. Right now is a time to 
concentrate on racing.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I mean, got any for yourself, Royce? Love 
stories, that is.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...No. Th-Then how about stories of 
something that made your heart flutter 
recently?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nothing in particular.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Oh! I got brand-new horseshoes 
after the Derby! Seeing those sparkling 
horseshoes made my heart flutter!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
For me, it's the training camp breakfast. 
They give you a banana every morning, 
right? That thoughtful touch really 
touched my heart.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of Banana-senpai! ...Wait, 
no!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Is there really anything... refreshing or 
youthful about this conversation, I 
wonder...?)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...And so, Operation 'Youthful Training 
Camp Night☆' ended in complete failure...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry, even though you helped keep 
watch too, Trainer."
choice_data_list:
Maybe I tried to close the distance too 
quickly...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"True. Also, how do you capture that 
'youthful vibe'? Like the kind of 
atmosphere you see in dramas or manga... I 
wonder how you create that..."
choice_data_list:
Then how about practicing with someone 
you're close to first?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see! First, I'll hang out with the usual 
crew and get the hang of this whole 
youthful vibe!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hum hum, tra-la-la~♪ Barbecue, 
barbecue~♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the invitation, Royce-san. 
Um, would it be all right if I invited 
McQueen-san as well?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Having people outside the usual 
crew might teach me a thing or two about 
youthful vibes!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you planning to learn about youth 
from this barbecue, Royce-san?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'd be glad to help! Let's 
see... how about we make some memories to 
deepen our bond?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun! Slipping away from the group 
is such a classic manga trope, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then come mountain stream fishing with me. 
We need to procure some fish anyway.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo too, Turbo too! Royce, let's go 
gather seashells at the beach with Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Being invited by both of you feels so 
youthful! But don't we need permits for 
mountain stream fishing and clam digging?
choice_data_list: Permission was granted, so it's all right.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. In that case, Trainer, which one 
would be better to refer to for 
youthfulness?"
choice_data_list: Free-diving for shellfish with Twin Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me. Let's play an 
unforgettable song of youth!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So... is it really okay for me to just 
fish normally?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì. Memories aren't something you make, 
but rather something that forms naturally, 
isn't that so?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ah! It just gave a little twitch!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Wait—eek!

Suddenly, the fishing rod bent sharply. 
Pulled by the rod, Royce and Royce fell 
right into the river—!

I toss aside the net and catch her just in 
the nick of time. I grab onto the fishing 
rod as well, but—it won't budge an inch.
choice_data_list: I can't catch anything at all...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Um, w-when you talk right in my ear like 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer, I don't think there's any 
need to hold your breath, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Let's tire the fish out before reeling it 
in. Swing the rod left and right along 
with the calls!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Here we go: uno, due, tre! Uno, due, tre!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: U... Uno, due, tre!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Uno, due, tre!!
(SPLAAAASHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Bravo! She's the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That was a magnificent duet. Hehe, didn't 
that become a song of our youth?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Were you surprised by us being 
closer than usual...?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm glad I could be of help. I'll 
head back first, so Royce-san and the 
others, take your time coming back.

Walking with Royce and Royce while gazing 
at the sea at sunset... an Umamusume 
standing quietly on the beach caught my 
eye.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Is that... Teio-san?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, dashed to the ocean! Turbo at 
fuuuull throttle!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Let's see who can catch more! Let's go, 
Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Sure, sounds great!

The two dove into the sea at the same 
time. Their figures sank deep into the 
indigo waters, disappearing from sight. 
After a while—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*! *pant*, *pant*, *pant*... Where is 
Turbo-san...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What's up, what's up, you're tapping out 
early, Royce! Turbo's still totally good 
to go!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Mmph... As a hard-working girl, I can't be 
the first one to throw in the towel!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Puha! *pant, pant, pant*...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Grrr... not yet, I'm not done yettt!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*wheeeeeze*, *wheeeeeze*... *ugh*, 
*cough*, *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eheheheheheheheee! Another win for Turbo! 
Turbo's the strooongeeeest!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Don't stop me... I can still keep 
going...!
choice_data_list:
If we keep going, I'll overlap with 
Turbo's whole gimmick!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose you're right. How unlike 
me... I got far too carried away.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
How's that, give up yet?! But you did 
great too, Royce! Handshake!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
After competing fiercely, they acknowledge 
one another... Heh, what a picture-perfect 
scene of youth...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's gonna go show this shell to 
everyone! See ya later, byeeeee!

Walking with Royce and Royce while gazing 
at the sea at sunset... an Umamusume 
standing quietly on the beach caught my 
eye.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Is that... Teio-san?

Tokai Teio stood gazing blankly at the 
sea. Her eyes seemed to reflect nothing at 
all...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even if you join the training camp, you 
won't be able to train properly... It must 
be quite frustrating...

Tokai Teio, who had been resting since 
last year's Arima Kinen, was scheduled to 
make her comeback in the Takarazuka Kinen.

However, a few days before the race, it 
was announced that she would be sidelined 
once more due to an avulsion fracture in 
her left leg.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Te-i-o-san! Are you by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Royce. Yeah, just wandering around 
on my own for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
My! Then why not have a barbecue with us? 
We're just about to throw a big party 
together.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san is here too, and Ikuno-san said 
she's going to invite McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: So...— Hey, what do you think?
choice_data_list:
Since we came all the way out to the 
training camp and all.

Since we came all the way out to the 
training camp and all, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! Maybe I'll join in too!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! It's Teio! Teio, Teio! Want some 
meat!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: First, a drink. Here you go, milk.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here, eat some yakisoba too. I piled it 
high with meat and veggies.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, hold on! Don't bring them all over 
at once—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, we are being welcomed, it seems. 
If you wish, we have sweets prepared as 
well.

She is Mejiro McQueen, young lady of the 
Mejiro family. In last year's Tenno Sho 
(Spring), she staged the clash of the 
century against Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you do, fill your belly first. 
You can't fight on an empty stomach, as 
they say.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, come autumn, I'll be heading 
back to the battlefield too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
! Nature... Your injury... it's all healed 
up.

Nice Nature, too, was currently 
recuperating after discovering a bone 
fracture following this spring's Osaka 
Hai.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, things are going smoothly so far. 
...So, y'know. Um—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh—You eat plenty too! Here, have some 
yakisoba!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, proven by Nature herself? Then I'm 
gonna stuff my belly full too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This is it, exactly this. 
Friendship, and youth...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Because we're both racers, we understand 
each other well...
choice_data_list:
Don't just stand there watching, Lois, 
come join in!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's right. I need to go learn how 
to build a relationship like that with BNW 
too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-saaan! Can I get some yakisoba 
too~?
